My research lies at the intersection of complex and symplectic geometry and functional analysis. I am mainly interested in the topics of Bergman kernel asymptotics and Berezin–Toeplitz quantization.

Publications

  • With Xiaonan Ma and Lei Wang, Fubini–Study forms on punctured Riemann Surfaces, CR Math. Acad. Sci. Paris 363 (2025), 603–615.

Preprints

  • Asymptotics for Toeplitz operators with symbol an indicator function, available at arXiv:2606.24503 (2026).
